document: Alone Against the Dark Defying the Triumph of the Ice (A Solo Play Call of Cthulhu Mini Campaign) Chaosium Publication 23154 (Matthew Costello, Mike Mason, Petr Štovik etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
The pit opens into a great maw of a cavern, a stellated dome with 
odd chinks of light glowing from the points. One of the bubble-mass 
creatures is at a pedestal, fingering something, which looks like a 
crystal top. With a slimy appendage, it thoughtfully fingers the Top. 
Make a Sanity roll and lose 1D6/1D20 Sanity points.
A successful Throw roll allows you to toss dynamite—if you 
have it. If you succeed, go to 569. If you have the rose-colored 
amulet, go to 571. If neither applies, you must go to 574.
(580)
